checks.clamp:
for value in range(-10, 11):
    self.assertEqual(solve(value, -2, 4), min(max(value, -2), 4))
checks.mean:
for values in ([1, 2, 4], [-3, 1, 7], [0], [1.5, 2.5]):
    self.assertAlmostEqual(solve(values), sum(values) / len(values))
checks.median:
for values, expected in (([8, 1, 4, 2], 3), ([1, 1, 9, 9], 5), ([5, 2, 1, 4, 3], 3)):
    self.assertEqual(solve(values), expected)
checks.none-default:
for value in (False, [], {}, 0, '', None):
    self.assertEqual(solve(value, 'default'), 'default' if value is None else value)
checks.export-contract:
for record in ({'z': [], 'b': None, 'a': 0}, {'second': False, 'first': ''}, {}):
    self.assertEqual(export(record, 'missing'), [(key, 'missing' if value is None else value) for key, value in record.items()])
